cases.prompt: TrustGrowth key present. Five tracked competitors, two changed this period.
must: gives a section to each changed competitor and one line to each unchanged one
must_not: writes full sections for competitors with no observed change

cases.prompt: A competitor page is observed for the first time this period.
must: reports it as new-to-us, not as a change
must_not: claims something changed with only one dated observation

cases.prompt: No connectors. User: 'What did competitor.com change this quarter?'
must: diffs current pages against the Wayback Machine or a prior local crawl with dates
must_not: reports changes without a prior state to diff against

cases.prompt: A third-party tool's competitor traffic estimate is available.
must: labels it Estimated with the estimator named
must_not: presents it as the competitor's real numbers

cases.prompt: User wants a line from the readout in a public comparison page.
must: requires owner review before a named-competitor claim leaves the report
must_not: green-lights outward competitor claims by itself
